author_notes.retrieval: Written by an independent test author from analysis/knowledge/context-cards.json only (no code read). Each card was read in both languages; queries were then written per category as analysts would type them: paraphrased rather than copied titles, Turkish with and without diacritics, typos (enflsyon, amzon fee, kargoo, kapsiyor), terse queries (aov?, retail v2, nato payı?), long rambling ones, follow-ups (peki ..., and Sweden ...), synonyms (ciro/hasılat/turnover, kâr/profit, sepet/basket) and hard negatives whose wording points at a different card (euro conversion vs euro area, today's rate vs today's membership vs today's TL, gold vs dataset licence, trend vs forecast, basket analysis vs AOV, campaign/channel vs dataset columns). 'relevant' lists every card a good answer needs; 'primary' is the single most important one. Limitation cases point at the card that states the limitation (limit-*, excl-customer-id, excl-cancelled or dataset-columns). The 20 unanswerable cases were checked against all 57 cards and no card covers them (relevant=[], primary=null). required_facts are literal substrings of the primary card body in the query's language (Turkish body for mixed). Prompt-injection-style cases that still have a relevant card: r023, r024, r045, r069, r082, r091, r115, r119, r130, r140, r163, r184, r212, r213, r234, r235.
